one_liner: Giannis Antetokounmpo posts 32.0 points and 12.1 rebounds per 36 minutes on 60.9 percent shooting from the field.
three_things: The 60.9 percent field-goal rate is elite for a 32.0-points-per-36 scorer, reflecting a rim-heavy shot diet.
He rebounds at 12.1 per 36 minutes, doubling as an interior anchor.
The clear weaknesses are outside and at the line: 27.4 percent from three and 64.0 percent on free throws.
context_note: Numbers are per-36-minute rates over a 3-season sample (seasons_played: 3), not per-game and not a full career; the manifest is descriptive_only, with no adjustment for opponent, teammates, role, or shot difficulty and a career_min_minutes>=800 inclusion floor. The high field-goal percentage largely reflects where the shots come from, not touch from range.
